hints.title: Interval Partitioning
hints.text: For subarray stoneValue[i..j], Alice partitions it into two non-empty segments stoneValue[i..k] and stoneValue[k+1..j].

hints.title: Bobs Elimination Rule
hints.text: Bob discards the segment with larger sum. If sums are equal, Alice chooses which segment to retain.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Transitions
hints.text: Compute prefix sums to calculate segment sums in O(1). Transition dp(i, j) maximizes retained row sum plus child subproblem score.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating game configurations recursively without memoization is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval DP memoizes O(N^2) subsegments, with O(N) split checks per state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formalizes interval DP with prefix sum range queries.
complexity.notes: Can also be optimized to O(N^2) using range maximum queries.
